title: a file with a broken JITSO block is an environment error (exit 3) that names the file and a line, for both the apply and the remove
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D8 (setup instructions, defect N-18): a delimited, reversible JITSO block in the instruction files agents read
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-18, setup instructions). A BEGIN without an END, an END without a BEGIN, an END before its BEGIN, two blocks and a BEGIN inside a block are refused: exit 3, `jitso: AGENTS.md has a broken JITSO block (<problem> at line <n>); fix or remove the marker lines by hand; nothing written` on stderr, empty stdout, the file untouched, no backup. `--remove` refuses them the same way.
